title: Prove hosted machine code routing to the engine
text: Consumer source adoption of explicit-org machine_authorization.handoff and handoff_poll has been observed against the merged public producer contract. This does not prove deployed hosted routing, personal approval, terminal pending-to-consumed behavior or one-time credential delivery. The hosted consumer owns exact-candidate integration and production captures, including same-org replay, other-org refusal with fresh-connection recovery and below-floor operator rollout recovery. Its Members controls retire only when the materialized Team contract declares the people destination; production evidence must prove the same predicate on both UI and old site controls. Keep this gap open until those deployed proofs exist; engine tests and source review alone do not close it.
